newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Legend Group to cut PC prices 10 percent.
newsitem.headline: China's Legend Group to cut PC prices 10 percent.

text.p: China's Legend Group is to cut prices of its personal computers (PCs) by an average 10 percent from this month, the Securities Daily on Thursday quoted company vice-president Yang Yuanqing as saying.

The group, one of China's top computer makers, could afford the price cuts because of outstanding sales and profits during the first half, Yang said. The price cuts would be introduced in mid-November.
Chinese personal computer prices have tumbled in recent months because of fierce competition between foreign and domestic producers, official newspapers have said.
Legend, a state-owned group that is China's largest domestic PC supplier, sold more than 80,000 PCs in the first half of 1996, up 126 percent compared with the same period last year, they said.
